title: Kantian Deontology Meets AI Alignment: Towards Morally Grounded Fairness Metrics

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical and philosophical analysis using Kantian deontology (specifically the Formula of Humanity) applied to a retrospective case study of mortgage-approval algorithms that disproportionately rejected racial minorities.

Philosophical critique of algorithmic decision-making processes, specifically analyzing the penalization of loan applicants relying on the gig economy and the penalization of students from disadvantaged or low-performing schools (the Ofqual algorithm controversy) through the lens of Kantian procedural fairness.
Brief conceptual evaluation using the Ofqual grading system controversy to contrast utilitarian and deontological approaches to evaluating predicted grade disparities between boys and girls.
